note: The shared application catalog (design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-11-evidence-product-design.md, section 3 decision 5). One entry per application a builder wants, with the options that change a measured quantity. No numbers live here: tools/applications.py assesses each board from data/results/ and the evidence files named in 'evidence', and renders the block on every board page and the catalog page site/applications.html. An option choice maps to result variants; a choice with 'needs' is unavailable on a chip whose core (data/boards.csv) or extras (site/data/portfolio.json) do not name it.

applications.title: Room occupancy on the chip
applications.outcome: Tell an occupied room from an empty one from a short window of sensor readings, on the microcontroller itself, with no cloud.
applications.question: Will the room-occupancy model fit on this board, does it give the right answers, and how long does one answer take?
applications.what_it_is: Four sizes of the same small neural network (about 500 to 30,000 parameters), trained on a public occupancy dataset (temperature, humidity, light, CO2). Each build runs 20 known windows and must classify all 20 right.

choices.label: TI's neural network compiler, on the CPU
